description: Current SDR behavior is pinned to Freecut. Linear display-referred BT.709 HDR uses straight alpha and 1.0 = 203 cd/m². Unmigrated operators throw HdrRenderUnavailableError; refusal is regression coverage, not HDR rendering qualification.

workingSpace.sdr: sRGB-encoded BT.709; pinned upstream parameters and clamps
workingSpace.hdr: linear display-referred BT.709, straight alpha, 1.0 = 203 cd/m²

gpu-ascii.semantics: SDR retains pinned parameters, clamps, endpoints and directions. HDR is typed-refused until this operator is migrated and measured in the linear working domain.

gpu-box-blur.semantics: HDR filters linear display-light BT.709 (1.0 = 203 cd/m²) with the pinned spatial kernel and bounded parameters. Bilinear taps accumulate premultiplied RGB and alpha; the result returns straight alpha, zero RGB for zero coverage, signed binary16 RGB limits, and unclipped headroom. SDR retains pinned encoded straight-RGBA hardware sampling and averaging.

gpu-brightness.semantics: HDR adds amount in linear display-light BT.709 reference-white units (1.0 = 203 cd/m²), clamps RGB only to the signed binary16 range, and preserves straight alpha. SDR retains its pinned encoded addition and [0, 1] clamp.

gpu-bulge.semantics: SDR retains pinned geometry and hardware straight-RGBA sampling. HDR retains the same coordinates, bilinearly samples premultiplied linear light, and returns signed straight RGB with binary16 coverage; zero stored coverage clears RGB.

gpu-contrast.semantics: HDR uses (linear RGB - 0.5) * amount + 0.5 around a fixed 0.5 reference-white pivot (101.5 cd/m² at 203 cd/m²), dimensionless gain bounded to [0, 3], signed binary16 RGB limits and unchanged straight alpha. SDR retains its pinned encoded 0.5 pivot and [0, 1] RGB clamp.

gpu-exposure.semantics: HDR multiplies linear RGB by 2^exposure (EV [-3, 3]), adds offset [-0.5, 0.5] in reference-white units ([-101.5, 101.5] cd/m² at 203 cd/m²), then applies sign(x)*abs(x)^(1/gamma), gamma [0.2, 3], about unit reference white. This artistic signed power is not a transfer-function conversion. Signed binary16 RGB limits and straight alpha are retained. SDR keeps encoded gain/offset, unsigned gamma and [0, 1] RGB clamp.

historicalEncodedHdr.acceptance: Historical extended sRGB-encoded contract only; cannot qualify current linear HDR.

contract.description: FL-97 HDR parameter semantics for every registered GPU effect. SDR projects keep Freecut reference behaviour (sdrClamped effects clamp to [0, 1] as upstream). In HDR projects the rgba16float route works in extended-range sRGB encoding with BT.709 primaries, 1.0 = reference white (203 cd/m² by default), negative values carrying wide gamut. hdr: extended = no clamp beyond the rgba16float finite limit; bounded = output within [0, 1] by design; palette = maps onto authored SDR colours. Verified by tools/effects-matrix.browser.mjs.

workingSpace.hdr: extended-range sRGB encoding, BT.709 primaries, 1.0 = referenceWhiteNits

gpu-ascii.semantics: Stylised glyph rendering with SDR ink/background colours; output is bounded to [0, 1] by design.

gpu-blocks.semantics: Block shading multiplies working values; no clamp in HDR.

gpu-box-blur.semantics: Weighted average of working values; linear, so range and sign are preserved.

gpu-brightness.semantics: Adds the amount in working units; 1.0 is reference white, so +0.1 lifts by 10% of reference white at every level, highlights included.

gpu-bulge.semantics: Resamples working values at displaced coordinates; range and sign are preserved.

gpu-chroma-key.semantics: Key distance uses CbCr of the working value; keyed alpha is bounded coverage, colour keeps its range, and spill suppression is additive.

gpu-color-wheels.semantics: Lift/gamma/gain, exposure, contrast and hue act on working values with a sign-preserving gamma; no clamp in HDR.

gpu-contrast.semantics: Scales around the 0.5 encoded pivot; values above reference white keep scaling rather than clipping.

gpu-crt.semantics: Curvature, scanlines and vignette multiply working values.

gpu-curves.semantics: The curve is defined on [0, 1]; values outside it take the curve end value plus their out-of-domain offset, so highlights keep their separation.

gpu-dither.semantics: Ordered/diffusion dither to an SDR palette; output is bounded to [0, 1] by design.

gpu-droste.semantics: Resamples working values at displaced coordinates; range and sign are preserved.

gpu-edge-detect.semantics: Edge magnitude as a [0, 1] mask colour; output is bounded by design.

gpu-exposure.semantics: Multiplies by 2^stops, adds the offset, then applies a sign-preserving gamma, so negative wide-gamut values keep their sign.

gpu-fluted-glass.semantics: Refraction resamples working values; highlight/shadow shading is additive and unclamped in HDR.

gpu-gaussian-blur.semantics: Weighted average of working values; linear, so range and sign are preserved.

gpu-glass-mosaic.semantics: Refraction resamples working values; highlight/shadow shading is additive and unclamped in HDR.

gpu-glow.semantics: Adds a thresholded bloom of working values; bright light blooms brighter in HDR.

gpu-gradient-map.semantics: Maps Rec.601 luma clamped to [0, 1] onto the authored gradient colours; the gradient is an SDR palette. Mix keeps the unmapped source share unchanged.

gpu-grain.semantics: Additive noise scaled by amount; highlights keep their level plus grain.

gpu-grayscale.semantics: Luma of the working value; highlights stay above 1.

gpu-halftone.semantics: Halftone dots in authored SDR ink colours; output is bounded to [0, 1] by design.

gpu-hue-shift.semantics: HSV rotation of the working value; V may exceed 1.

gpu-ink.semantics: Ink hatch in authored SDR colours; output is bounded to [0, 1] by design.

gpu-invert.semantics: Reflects about reference white (1 - x); light above reference white becomes negative, which is kept.

gpu-kaleidoscope.semantics: Resamples working values at displaced coordinates; range and sign are preserved.

gpu-levels.semantics: Input black/white set the reference segment; light past input white continues past output white on the same slope. A collapsed input range is a hard threshold.

gpu-lut.semantics: The 3D LUT is defined on [0, 1]; values outside it take the LUT result plus their out-of-domain offset. No LUT is assumed to be an HDR transform.

gpu-mirror.semantics: Resamples working values at displaced coordinates; range and sign are preserved.

gpu-motion-blur.semantics: Weighted average of working values; linear, so range and sign are preserved.

gpu-pixel-sort.semantics: Reorders working values by the sort key; values are moved, not changed.

gpu-pixel-sort-hq.semantics: Reorders working values by the sort key; values are moved, not changed.

gpu-pixelate.semantics: Resamples working values at displaced coordinates; range and sign are preserved.

gpu-posterize.semantics: Quantises working values in 1/levels steps across the whole range.

gpu-power-window.semantics: Window mask is geometric; the correction applies to extended values without clipping them.

gpu-radial-blur.semantics: Weighted average of working values; linear, so range and sign are preserved.

gpu-rgb-split.semantics: Resamples working values at displaced coordinates; range and sign are preserved.

gpu-ripple-glass.semantics: Refraction resamples working values; highlight/shadow shading is additive and unclamped in HDR.

gpu-saturation.semantics: Mixes with Rec.601 luma of the working value; extended values stay extended.

gpu-scanlines.semantics: Multiplies working values by the scanline pattern.

gpu-secondary-qualifier.semantics: The qualifier mask is computed from HSL with a [0, 1] mask; the correction applies to extended values without clipping them.

gpu-sepia.semantics: Fixed sepia matrix applied to the working value; bright input gives bright sepia.

gpu-sharpen.semantics: Unsharp mask on working values; overshoot above reference white and below zero is kept in HDR.

gpu-temperature.semantics: Additive warm/cool and tint offsets in working units; no clamp in HDR.

gpu-threshold.semantics: Binary threshold of luma to 0 or 1 (reference white); output is bounded by design.

gpu-trigger-wave.semantics: Displacement plus an additive glow band over working values; unclamped in HDR.

gpu-twirl.semantics: Resamples working values at displaced coordinates; range and sign are preserved.

gpu-vhs.semantics: Tape distortion, bleed, scanlines and noise over working values; no clamp in HDR.

gpu-vibrance.semantics: Saturation weighted by current saturation; extended values stay extended.

gpu-vignette.semantics: Multiplies working values by the vignette falloff.

gpu-wave.semantics: Resamples working values at displaced coordinates; range and sign are preserved.

gpu-zoom-blur.semantics: Weighted average of working values; linear, so range and sign are preserved.
